overview: Manitoba's signature sport fish. Lake Winnipeg's famous green-backed walleye draw ice anglers from around the world, while the Red River offers a strong fall run near Lockport.
techniques: Jigging live minnows near bottom on structure
Trolling crankbaits along contours in open water
Drifting with bottom bouncers and nightcrawlers
Ice fishing with rattle baits and jigging spoons
Deadstick rod with live bait next to an active jigging rod
best_seasons: Spring and fall open water; September-October fall run on the Red River; prime ice fishing December through March.

overview: Manitoba's aggressive ambush predator, found in everything from Lake Winnipeg's bays to remote northern fly-in lakes, with true trophy potential.
techniques: Casting spoons, spinnerbaits and jerkbaits along weed edges and rocky points
Fly fishing with large streamers and poppers on an 8-weight rod
Ice fishing with tip-ups baited with large shiners or sucker minnows
Trolling to cover water and locate active fish
baits: Large shiners or sucker minnows on tip-ups
best_seasons: Spring, when pike pack into warming bays and river mouths; steady summer action on weedlines; fall for trophy fish on points and windblown shorelines; winter ice season with tip-ups.

overview: Deep, cold shield lakes in northern Manitoba — Lake Athapapuskow, Clearwater, the Cranberry Chain, Wekusko and Kississing — hold some of the biggest lake trout anywhere, and they're very catchable through the ice.
techniques: Jigging heavy tubes, jigs and spoons on deep structure
Dead sticking with ciscos on points or saddles
Trolling deep with downriggers or lead-core line in summer
Casting bucktail jigs in shallow water during spring and fall
best_seasons: Winter through the ice; late August to early September when big females move onto shallow rocky reefs for the fall spawn; early spring when trout ride higher in the water column.

overview: The Red River below the Lockport Dam is one of North America's premier trophy channel cat fisheries, with 20-plus-pound fish common and 30-pounders attainable.
techniques: Slip-sinker bottom rigging behind an anchored boat
Slip-bobber float fishing along current edges
Anchoring at the head or edge of holes and casting rigs downriver
best_seasons: Late May-June prespawn bite in tailwaters is the peak; fishing stays strong through summer and into October.

overview: Clear Canadian Shield lakes in Nopiming and Whiteshell Provincial Parks grow aggressive smallmouth that feed heavily on crayfish around rocks and boulders.
techniques: Casting tube jigs along rocky points and boulders
Drop shotting near deeper structure
Jerkbait retrieves along shorelines
Topwater walking baits early in the day
Finesse presentations on subtle points and corners
best_seasons: Late spring through early fall; late fall can produce when fish school up.

overview: Manitoba's Interlake shoal lakes produce jumbo perch, and Lake Winnipeg perch keep ice anglers busy all winter with fast, tasty action.
techniques: Jigging small tungsten jigs and spoons tipped with bait
Dead sticking with live minnows on ultra-light rods
Rattle baits when perch are aggressive
best_seasons: Winter ice season, especially late ice in March when perch move shallow; summer jigging in deeper water.

overview: Manitoba's freshwater cod is a winter specialty — Cedar Lake is famous for its burbot spawn under the ice, and the Red River's deeper stretches hold them too.
techniques: Night jigging with heavy glow spoons
Dead sticking with scented bait near bottom
Tip-ups rigged just off bottom overnight
best_seasons: Winter, peaking around the March spawn under the ice.

overview: An underrated ice-fishing target in Manitoba — Lake Winnipeg and Cedar Lake both hold trophy-class whitefish that reward a finesse approach.
techniques: Finesse jigging with compact spoons and jigs
Staying mobile to locate roaming schools
Light presentations that keep the lure above the fish

overview: A Manitoba river classic — bright silver, eager biters in the Red, Assiniboine and Winnipeg Rivers, and the province's famous smoked fish delicacy.
techniques: Slip-bobber fishing with worms close to shore
Casting small spinners, spoons and jigs
best_seasons: Spring and early summer as river water warms; active through the summer months.

overview: Manitoba stocks rainbows in lakes like Footprint Lake and throughout the Whiteshell, giving shore and ice anglers fun, hard-fighting trout close to home.
techniques: Still fishing with a small jig and nightcrawler a foot or two off bottom
Casting small spoons and spinners
Fly fishing with streamers and leech patterns in fall
best_seasons: Fall, when stocked trout feed aggressively on shallow weed flats; winter through the ice; spring after ice-out.
